faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DoT Junior Engineer (Telecom)[JE(T)] recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DoT Junior Engineer (Telecom)[JE(T)] posts is 30th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Junior Engineer (Telecom)[JE(T)] position is 65 years. There is no minimum age specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Junior Engineer (Telecom)[JE(T)] post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary equivalent to Level 6 of the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC). The exact consolidated fee will be as per the Department of Expenditure (DoE) OM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the DoT Junior Engineer (Telecom)[JE(T)] recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications required for the JE(T) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be retired from Central/State Govt/PSU/Research organizations at Level-6/7 of the 7th CPC or equivalent. Proficiency in computers and MS Office/Internet is also required.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any preference given to candidates from specific organizations?
faq.answer: Yes, preference will be given to candidates who have a background from DoT, BSNL, or MTNL.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Junior Engineer (Telecom)[JE(T)] post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the DoT JE(T) recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Merit List followed by an Interaction/Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any application fees for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there are no application fees for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Department of Telecommunications. Links are provided in the 'Important Links' section.
